constraints.name: activity_assignments_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (ended_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'finished'::text) AND (ended_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: agents_membership_pair
constraints.def: CHECK ((((membership_status = 'active'::text) AND (suspended_at IS NULL) AND (suspension_reason IS NULL)) OR ((membership_status = 'suspended'::text) AND (suspended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (suspension_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((char_length(suspension_reason) >= 1) AND (char_length(suspension_reason) <= 200)))))

constraints.name: company_command_receipts_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((status = 'in_flight'::text) AND (applied_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'applied'::text) AND (applied_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: dispositions_status_pair
constraints.def: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (retired_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'retired'::text) AND (retired_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: internal_conversations_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((kind = 'group'::text) AND (sector_id IS NOT NULL) AND (pair_key IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'direct'::text) AND (sector_id IS NULL) AND (pair_key IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: messages_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((sender_type = 'system'::text) AND (sender_id IS NULL)) OR ((sender_type <> 'system'::text) AND (sender_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: sites_pause_reason_pair
constraints.def: CHECK ((((acceptance = 'accepting'::text) AND (pause_reason IS NULL)) OR ((acceptance = 'paused'::text) AND (pause_reason IS NOT NULL) AND ((char_length(pause_reason) >= 1) AND (char_length(pause_reason) <= 200)))))

constraints.name: sla_policies_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (retired_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'retired'::text) AND (retired_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_at >= effective_from))))

constraints.name: sla_policies_no_overlap
constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING gist (queue_id WITH =, tstzrange(effective_from, retired_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)
